newsitem.title: USA: Checkpoint Systems gets biggest contract.
newsitem.headline: Checkpoint Systems gets biggest contract.

text.p: Checkpoint Systems Inc said Monday that it will install its radio frequency electronic article surveillance systems in over 1,650 American Stores Co operations nationwide.
Checkpoint said the deal represents the largest single contract in its history, but did not immediately disclose its dollar value.
Checkpoint subsequently said the contract, combined with a deal to supply Bi-Lo Inc, is valued at about $20 million over several years.
The company said that Bi-Lo, a division of Koninklijke Ahold NV, will expand use of Checkpoint's systems from its current 55 stores to the remaining 205 stores in the chain.
